00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000023.title: Mara’s return
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000023.synopsis: The spine of the book: a woman goes home to an island that is not where she left it, and decides whether to stay long enough to remember.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000023.notes: Every scene on this thread moves Mara physically closer to the white house or further from the mainland.

00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000024.title: The changing map
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000024.synopsis: The island’s geography follows memory. Places people forget disappear; places someone remembers too hard move. The little map is the only honest witness.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000024.notes: Never explain the mechanism in dialogue. Show it on the map, then in the landscape, in that order.
